courses.title: Summer Internship
courses.course_description: This course prepares students participating in internships through Experiential Learning to excel in their careers. This is done by facilitating thoughtful connections between students’ academic, professional, and personal goals. Assignments given will allow students to reflect on how their knowledge, skills, and strengths can be applied to their internships. This introductory course to Experiential Learning helps students build skills for success in professional settings through knowledge and self-reflection. Students will utilize career readiness tools, learn networking techniques, and develop professional communication skills.

courses.title: Undergraduate Virtual Internship
courses.course_description: This course offers a zero-credit course for an internship experience delivered by Virtual Internships. Learners complete a minimum of 120 verified internship hours with a global host company. Through weekly feedback loops, self-assessments, structured reflections, and coaching touchpoints, learners actively apply and document their growth. The course culminates in a Reflective Essay designed to connect internship outcomes with future academic and professional goals. This holistic program bridges academic learning with real-world experience, equipping students for long-term career success.
